summary: Re-validated the high-priority admin login/throttle fix via public URL. Required 8-test regression suite passed (8/8), additional X-Forwarded-For throttle regression passed, and browser login session flow works without Origin rejection.
action_items: No blocker from this scope. Keep running test_login_priority_regression.py and test_login_throttle_xff_regression.py in auth regression CI.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py still uses FastAPI on_event startup/shutdown hooks (deprecation warnings observed); migrate to lifespan handlers in a future refactor.
backend/server.py remains very large (>700 lines) and should be split by domain for maintainability and safer auth changes.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 targeted tests passed: 8 regression + 1 forwarded-header lockout test)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use public URL from frontend/.env. Admin credentials unchanged (admin/admin). Lockout behavior confirmed username-scoped and not bypassed by varying X-Forwarded-For headers. Browser flow confirmed: /login -> /app/stok, reload persists, logout blocks /app/stok and redirects to /login.
rca of the issue: Original high issue was lockout-key fragmentation behind ingress/proxy. Current implementation now keys attempts by SHA256('username:'+normalized_username), increments atomically before bcrypt verification, enforces 429 on 6th failure, and successful login clears only matching account counter. Reproduced and validated as fixed through external URL and Mongo identifier checks.
